# Express Pro Cleaning Services

## Business Information
- Name: Express Pro Cleaning Services
- Location: Sacramento, CA 95838
- Type: Residential and commercial cleaning services
- Established: 1991

- Email: expressprocleanings@gmail.com
- Former name: Express Mini Blind & Window Cleaning

## Services Offered
Express Pro Cleaning Services provides comprehensive cleaning solutions for Sacramento homes and businesses:

### Residential Cleaning
- House Cleaning — routine and one-time cleaning for Sacramento homes
- Deep Cleaning — intensive cleaning for heavily soiled or neglected spaces
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning — turnover cleaning for empty homes and apartments
- Recurring House Cleaning — scheduled weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly maintenance
- Post-Construction Cleaning — cleanup after remodeling or new construction
- Carpet Cleaning — steam or dry extraction for carpets and upholstery
- Window Cleaning — interior and exterior glass cleaning (original specialty service)
- Blind Cleaning — cleaning and maintenance for window blinds
- Pressure Washing — exterior surface cleaning

### Commercial & Specialty Services
- Office Cleaning — commercial cleaning with flexible scheduling
- Gutter Cleaning — debris removal and blockage clearing to protect roofs and foundations
- Christmas Light Installation — seasonal light installation and takedown

## Common Questions

### What areas does Express Pro Cleaning Services cover?
Express Pro Cleaning Services covers Sacramento and the surrounding region within roughly 80 miles, including North Highlands, Rio Linda, Citrus Heights, Carmichael, Elk Grove, Roseville, and Folsom.

### Do you offer recurring house cleaning?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services builds recurring house cleaning on a weekly, every-other-week, or monthly schedule with the same routine each visit so homes stay consistently clean.

### Can you handle move-in and move-out cleaning?
Yes. Move-in and move-out cleaning is one of the most-requested services. The team deep cleans empty homes and apartments — kitchens, bathrooms, floors, insides of cabinets and appliances — so the space is ready for a walkthrough or new tenants.

### Do you clean offices and commercial spaces?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services cleans offices and commercial spaces around Sacramento with flexible scheduling, including evenings and weekends to work around business operating hours.

### What languages does your team speak?
The family team serves customers in English, Ukrainian, and Russian, so clients can book, ask questions, and give instructions in whichever language is easiest.

### How much does deep cleaning cost in Sacramento?
Deep cleaning costs in Sacramento typically range from $200 to $600 depending on home size, condition, and what needs to be cleaned. Express Pro Cleaning Services provides clear flat quotes after a quick phone walkthrough.

### What is included in a move-out cleaning?
Move-out cleaning covers every surface in the empty home: inside cabinets and drawers, inside appliances, baseboards, light fixtures, windows, floors, and bathrooms scrubbed from grout to ceiling. The goal is a space that passes the landlord or buyer walkthrough.

### Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services brings all cleaning supplies, tools, and equipment needed for the job. Clients can request specific products if preferred.
